posts.preview: ENDING THE WEEK WITH DETERMINATION TO IMPROVE THE WORKING AND LIVING CONDITIONS OF OUR PEOPLE

The Chairperson of the National Assembly Standing Committee on Poverty Eradication, Labour and Industrial Relations, Hon. Justina Jonas, has emphasised that the Committee’s role is not to oppose, apportion blame or assign fault, but to gather evidence-based findings and make recommendations to Parliament for deliber...
Today, the Committee is holding a consultative meeting with trade unions, ministries and agencies on conditions of employment in Namibia’s retail and wholesale sector.
On Monday, the Committee will conduct oversight visits to retail shops in Windhoek to assess compliance with mandatory wage requirements, the Labour Act and other relevant legislation.
